description: This file is a C source file implementing a GTK application with Flutter integration for Linux. It defines the application lifecycle, window setup, and plugin registration.

classes.name: MyApplication
classes.description: A GTK application class integrating Flutter for Linux, managing window setup, plugin registration, and application lifecycle.

methods.name: my_application_activate
methods.description: Handles application activation, creates main window, sets header or title bar based on environment, and initializes Flutter view.

methods.name: my_application_local_command_line
methods.description: Processes command line arguments, stores Dart entrypoint arguments, registers application, and activates it.

methods.name: my_application_startup
methods.description: Performs startup actions, calls parent startup method.

methods.name: my_application_shutdown
methods.description: Performs shutdown actions, calls parent shutdown method.

methods.name: my_application_dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, specifically frees Dart entrypoint arguments.

methods.name: my_application_class_init
methods.description: Initializes class methods for application lifecycle.

methods.name: my_application_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MyApplication, sets program name and application ID.
